checks.name: rv_hypothesis_match

checks.detail: The (s,t) rotation of the two original pair coordinates is used only as a Jacobian-one density transformation. Independence of s and t is never asserted. Joint density cap <=1 and marginal s cap <=sqrt(2) are the only properties used.
